description: Defines utilities and checks for Tensor-subclass-like objects in PyTorch, including functions to identify such tensors and handle scalar boolean tensors.

methods.name: isTensorSubclassLike
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is tensor-subclass-like based on its dispatch key set.

methods.name: areAnyTensorSubclassLike
methods.description: Checks if any tensor in a list is tensor-subclass-like.

methods.name: areAnyOptionalTensorSubclassLike
methods.description: Checks if any optional tensor in a list is tensor-subclass-like.

methods.name: is_scalar_tensor_true
methods.description: Determines if a scalar boolean tensor is true, assuming it is a scalar of boolean dtype.
